how_to_apply: Visit the official website of the Uttara Kannada District Court: uttarakannada.dcourts.gov.in.
Go to the "Notice Category – Recruitments" section or the "Online Recruitment" link on the website.
Read all instructions given on the online portal carefully before proceeding.
Register with a valid and correct email address and mobile number, as these cannot be corrected later.
Fill in the online application form and upload the required documents/certificates as applicable.
Pay the applicable application fee online through the SBI Collect page and upload the fee payment receipt.
Submit the application before 16.09.2026, 11:59 PM, and complete the fee payment before 17.09.2026.

Applications must be submitted only online; incomplete applications will be rejected without any correspondence. If a candidate submits more than one application, only the last (most recent) application will be considered.
important_instructions: All communication regarding the recruitment will be sent only to the email address and mobile number entered in the online application. The recruiting authority will not be responsible if a candidate does not receive an email or message due to an incorrect email address or mobile number. Candidates must appear for the written/qualifying test and interview at their own expense, at the venue notified by the office. Seeking any external support from staff or non-staff sources during the selection process will lead to disqualification of the candidature. If information provided in the application is found to be false at the time of verification, the candidature will be cancelled and criminal proceedings may be initiated against the candidate. This recruitment is subject to the final outcome of pending writ petitions No. 200448/2025, 17968/2025 and 3145/2023 before the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka.

content_sections.heading: Uttara Kannada District Court Process Server and Peon Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection to both posts will be made as per the Karnataka Civil Courts (Clerical and Other Posts) (Recruitment) Rules, 1982, and its amendment rules of 2007 and 2021. Process Server: Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying educational examination, in a ratio of 1:25 per post as per the reservation of notified posts. The interview carries a total of 10 marks, and final selection is based on marks obtained in the interview. Peon: Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on the percentage of marks obtained in the SSLC examination, in a ratio of 1:10 per post. The interview carries a total of 10 marks, and final selection is based on marks obtained in the interview. If two or more candidates secure equal marks, the order of merit will be decided on the basis of age, with the older candidate placed higher in the merit list. Selected candidates will be on probation for an initial period of two years, extendable if required.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Uttara Kannada District Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates called for document verification must produce the following original documents: SSLC original marks card or equivalent qualification marks card Original birth certificate (or SSLC marks card showing date of birth) Valid original reservation/caste certificate in the prescribed format, where applicable (SC/ST, Category-1, IIA, IIB, IIIA, IIIB) Persons with Disability certificate from a competent authority, where applicable Ex-servicemen discharge/release certificate from the District Sainik Board, where applicable Rural candidate certificate along with creamy layer certificate, where applicable Transgender certificate from competent authority, where applicable No Objection Certificate from the current employer, for government/PSU employees Project-displaced person certificate, where applicable Identity proof such as original Aadhaar card or voter ID card Character certificate from two respectable persons (not relatives) and from the principal of the last institution attended, not older than six months

If a candidate submits more than one application, only the last (most recent) application will be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is Uttara Kannada District Court Process Server and Peon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Uttara Kannada, Karwar, to fill 78 posts of Process Server and Peon in courts under the Uttara Kannada district court unit, as per Notification No. 1/2026 dated 05.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 78 vacancies are available — 13 for Process Server and 65 for Peon.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Uttara Kannada District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application can be submitted from 17.08.2026 to 16.09.2026 (up to 11:59 PM). The fee payment can be made until 17.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSLC or an equivalent examination for both Process Server and Peon posts. Peon candidates must also be able to read and write Kannada.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Uttara Kannada District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 18 years old as on the last date of application. The maximum age is 40 years for General category, 43 years for Category-II(A)/II(B)/III(A)/III(B), and 45 years for SC/ST and Category-I candidates, with additional relaxations as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹300 for General category candidates and ₹150 for Category-IIA, IIB, IIIA and IIIB candidates. SC, ST, Category-I and visibly disabled candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for Uttara Kannada District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website uttarakannada.dcourts.gov.in, using the "Notice Category – Recruitments" or "Online Recruitment" link, within the notified dates.
